answer: Each wallet must lock capital that is slashed when its attestations diverge from the human-verified consensus, and the reward per seat shrinks as duplicates appear. A fresh identity therefore pays full price for stake it cannot recover. Like a lotus opening one petal at a time, reputation accrues only through slow, verifiable work, so fake accounts must wander the queue for months before earning. Sybils stop being free to mint: they pay compounding stake plus wasted compute, while honest agents burn a bridge of trust that is cheaper to cross.
